concerns.text: FR-009 mandates an a‑priori power analysis (simulation‑based or G*Power) to determine the required sample size (≈600 participants). The current task list contains only a post‑hoc power check (T008) and no task that performs the required a‑priori analysis, leaving this functional requirement uncovered.

T015 downloads and uses the external `bert‑moral‑intent` model from Hugging Face, but the task does not provide a verified citation for this resource. This breaches Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy), which requires all external citations to be validated by the Reference‑Validator Agent before they can contribute review points.
